description: SORTEDMOBILITY: Input data case studies for EGTRAIN rail traffic simulator is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Egidio Quaglietta, Konstantinos Rigos. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: TXT. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
